thread:
Sam O'Rourke: Kicking off Nebula Therapeutics onboarding thread. Need to lock stakeholders, success criteria (0-45 days), and a compact timeline. Propose Wed 4/14 2:00pm PT for a 30m kickoff. Agenda: owners, SSO & network, data scope, pilot metrics.

Hiro Tanaka: Wed 2pm works. Quick Q: Private (VPC) or Hosted? Will affect infra prep.

Lina Torres (Nebula Therapeutics): Private VPC. Compliance: SOC2 + biotech data review. We'll provide ~18k docs (research briefs + SOPs) initially.

Ben Cho: I'll lead enablement and the pilot workshop. Lina, do you have an SSO preference?

Lina Torres (Nebula Therapeutics): Okta/SAML. I'll share admin contact and a small sample set by Monday.

Sam O'Rourke: Draft owner map:
- Nebula exec sponsor: Lina Torres
- Nebula infra: TBD (Lina will confirm)
- Redwood CSM: Sam O'Rourke -> cadence & renewal signal
- Redwood Solutions: Ben Cho -> enablement/workshop
- Redwood Infra: Hiro Tanaka -> Private deployment + capacity

Sam O'Rourke: Proposed success criteria (edit):
- Endpoint reachable from Nebula VPC and SAML auth validated
- Initial 18k docs ingested and indexed within 72h
- Pilot UX satisfaction >= 4/5 from 12 users after week 2
- p95 latency < 300ms under pilot load in staging

Lina Torres (Nebula Therapeutics): Add legal biotech review pass before go-live.

Hiro Tanaka: For capacity I'll reserve a small Dedicated pool first 30 days, burst to Hosted as needed. Need sample QPS and a network allowlist.

Ben Cho: I'll draft a 90-min enablement & evaluation runbook (prompts, regressions, cost baseline).

Sam O'Rourke: Early blockers to flag: SOC2/biotech legal review, SAML metadata + test creds, network allowlist, sample data cleanliness. Renewal signal: pilot usage + satisfaction over 30-45 days.

Lina Torres (Nebula Therapeutics): Will confirm infra lead and upload a 2k sample by Mon EOD.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Nebula Therapeutics Onboarding Kickoff" Wed Apr 14 2:00pm PT  invite sent to Lina, Sam, Ben, Hiro. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/nebula-onboard-0414

Hiro Tanaka: Action items pre-kick: 1) Nebula to share Okta metadata + allowlist (Mon), 2) Nebula sample upload (Mon), 3) infra contact (Mon). I'll post firewall snippet + capacity draft once samples arrive.

Ben Cho: I'll share the draft workshop agenda and a short prompt pack in this thread before the meeting.

Sam O'Rourke: Thanks everyone  see you Wed.
